verdict.rationale: Official docs explicitly state Ubuntu offers 'different choices of default desktop environment, applications and settings' backed by the full Ubuntu archive, and community threads corroborate real-world variety across Unity, GNOME, KDE, and Compiz-based setups. Missing for 10: explicit naming/branding of official flavors (Kubuntu, Xubuntu, Lubuntu, etc.) and a direct link to a flavors page confirming they are first-party/official rather than community forks.
